title: Lesson 3: Advanced Hermes Configuration: Model Routing, Evals, and Guardrails in Production
description: When the agent leaves the sandbox and runs at real volume in front of a client, three decisions decide whether it holds up: which model runs which task, how you prove the output is still correct, and how you keep the guardrails you documented actually enforced. This lesson teaches all three.
